title: Drag-and-Drop Interaction Patterns
summary: This reel breaks down the essential feedback loops for a seamless drag-and-drop experience. It covers pick-up signals, drop zone indicators, snapping logic, and error recovery via undo toasts.

transcript.text: Grab a card. The board does the thinking.
Cursor changes. Card lifts. Background fades.
Three signals say "I'm holding this". No signal feels stuck.
Hover a column, insertion line. Hover a zone, fill highlight.
Snap matches structure. Free matches canvas.
Kanban snaps to columns. Figma drops anywhere.
Snap for structured lists. Free for canvas.
Pick the wrong one and users fight your UI.
Bad drop. Toast. Five seconds to undo.
Happens. Toast pops. Moved to Done. Undo.
Five seconds to take it back. Saves the panic.
Follow for more interaction patterns. Save this for your next board.
